text: Differentiate $y = x^{4x}$ with respect to x.

Differentiate: $\dfrac{1}{y}\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 4\log x + 4$.

text: If $y = \sin 4x + \cos 4x$, show that $\dfrac{d^2y}{dx^2} + 16y = 0$.

$\dfrac{d^2y}{dx^2} = -16\sin 4x - 16\cos 4x$.
That is $-16y$, which gives the result.
